about: Fixed formulas that may appear in curriculum/ although a gold item also uses them. Only set phrases a learner must learn word for word (greetings, letter formulas, service openers) belong here, each with a reason. A content sentence never does. Read by scripts/check-leaks.mjs.

goldSentences.sentence: Was kann ich für Sie tun?
goldSentences.reason: Standard opener of a clerk at a counter or on the phone; learners must recognise it word for word.
Standard service opener of an office or help desk; there is no other natural wording.
The fixed salutation of a formal letter to an unknown recipient; taught as a vocabulary lemma and required in formal writing tasks.
Fixed formal thanks at the end of a call or letter, taught next to Mit freundlichen Grüßen.
Fixed opening thanks of an interview or panel; learners use it word for word.
Fixed discourse formula for gaining time before answering a question.

scriptRuns.reason: Fixed opening thanks of an interview; an anchor may open with it like the practice script does, and the next words must still differ.
